in_hebrew.name: Haldi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haldi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Helios', meaning 'Sun' or 'Sun god'. In ancient Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun, and his name is the root of the English word 'helianthus', meaning sunflower.

in_greek.name: Haldi
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Sun god
in_greek.long_meaning: Haldi είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'Helios', meaning 'Sun' or 'Sun god'. In ancient Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun, and his name is the root of the English word 'helianthus', meaning sunflower.

in_latin.name: Haldi
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Sun god
in_latin.long_meaning: Haldi est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'Helios', meaning 'Sun' or 'Sun god'. In ancient Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun, and his name is the root of the English word 'helianthus', meaning sunflower.
